subject: pgvector approximate-nearest-neighbor comparison

decision.reason: The currently registered real product corpus contains only eight documents. An exact-vs-HNSW-vs-IVFFlat comparison at this size would not answer a current product scale question, so PR #1 requires deferral rather than manufacturing an ANN winner.

supportingEvidence.limitation: Synthetic fixed-dimensional vectors and three timing samples per target are not real-corpus semantic quality evidence and are not used to select a production ANN index.

reevaluateWhen: A materially larger production-like registered corpus is available.
Measured exact-vector retrieval latency on that corpus creates a concrete scale question.
Recall@10, latency, build time, index size, RAM and incremental-update cost can all be measured on the same held-out corpus.
